completion_dependencies.software: INTREQR.BLIT waits/acknowledgements precede each packet; return and UI flags are not final waits.
completion_dependencies.interrupts: Setup clears enables then sets master+VERTB+COPER, not BLIT. Level3 samples raw requests and prefers COPER/VERTB before BLIT. Do not treat the frame-completion latch as a blitter fence.
completion_dependencies.bus: Setup enables BLITHOG. CPU border/text follows clear without software polling; hardware arbitration must be assessed separately.
completion_dependencies.warm_restart: Source456/45C polls DMACONR bit14 until not busy before supervisor setup/title reuse; this is an explicit transition fence.
completion_dependencies.token_assumptions: A completion request represents the preceding serialized packet; no intervening software synthesizes/stales/consumes the token, DMA remains enabled, and descriptor addresses/geometry retain the inspected values.
